questions.question: I usually ___ breakfast at 7 o'clock.
questions.explanation: Posiłki: have breakfast / lunch / dinner. „Robić śniadanie” w sensie przygotować to make breakfast, ale „jeść” to have.

questions.passage: Hi! My name is Marta. I'm from Gdańsk, but now I live in Kraków with my sister. I'm a student. I don't have a car, so I go to university by bike. At the weekend I visit my parents.
questions.question: How does Marta get to university?
questions.explanation: W tekście: „I go to university by bike”. Samochodu nie ma (I don't have a car).

questions.question: By the time we got to the cinema, the film ___.
questions.explanation: Czynność wcześniejsza niż inna czynność w przeszłości: Past Perfect (had started).

questions.passage: Hi Sam, the meeting has moved from Tuesday to Thursday because half the team is at a conference. Same room, same time. Could you tell Ola? She isn't on this mailing list. – Kasia
questions.question: Why is Kasia writing to Sam?
options: To ask Sam to pass on information
To invite Sam to a conference
questions.explanation: Spotkanie nie jest odwołane, tylko przeniesione, a sala ta sama. Najważniejsza prośba: „Could you tell Ola?” – Sam ma przekazać wiadomość.

questions.question: The new policy has ___ a lot of criticism from teachers.
questions.explanation: Kolokacja: draw criticism (spotkać się z krytyką). Podobnie draw attention.

questions.passage: Few things divide a household like the thermostat. One camp insists that 19 degrees is perfectly comfortable with a jumper on; the other quietly turns the dial up whenever the first leaves the room. Researchers who studied office temperatures found that the standard settings were based on the metabolic rate of a forty-year-old man – which may explain why so many people reach for a cardigan in July.
questions.question: What does the writer suggest about office temperatures?
options: They are usually set too high in summer.
They may not suit a large part of the people who work there.
They cause more arguments than temperatures at home.
They were designed after careful research on comfort.
questions.explanation: Ustawienia oparto na metabolizmie jednej grupy (40-letni mężczyzna), więc wiele osób marznie – nie pasują do dużej części pracowników.
